title: fix(packages): pricing the free setup package stops the invite link giving it away (AUDIT-02-125)
body:
Tier: T4 (money: who gets a package for $0)
Why: the setup wizard binds a free first package to the coach's invite link as a free grant; pricing that package later left the free grant on the link, so new clients kept getting a now-paid package for $0.
T4 trigger scan: money (package grants at $0, pricing). No auth, RLS, PII, credentials or destructive data paths touched.
T3 trigger scan: one service method (PackagesService.update, price-change transaction). No schema, migration, flag, lockfile or API contract change.
Bounded T1: none.
Canonical builder: AUDIT-02-125 (agent 125, Claude Opus 5.5).
Acceptance evidence: `test/package-free-invite-binding-release.spec.ts` (4 cases) fails on main (the binding stays) and passes here; PR CI runs the full suite and tsc.

## B fixed

**B-A02-1 (money given away).** A coach picks "Free" for the first package in setup, later opens Packages and changes that package to $49 a month, and every client who joins with the coach's invite link still gets it for $0 with no subscription, forever.
- Cause: `FirstPackageForm` binds the free package to the coach's permanent link with `grant_mode: 'free'` (PUT /v1/invite-codes/:code/package-binding). `InviteGrantService` grants a bound package at $0 whatever its current price, and `PackagesService.update` never touched the binding. The pricing lock does not stop the edit because free grants have no Stripe subscription.
- Fix (`src/packages/packages.service.ts`): inside the existing price-change transaction, when a package goes from free (`$0` one-time, no paid second price) to paid, clear the coach's `free` bindings to that package (CoachProfile link and InviteCode rows). Clients who already joined keep their grant. `prepaid` bindings (client paid outside the app) and every binding on an already-paid package are unchanged.
- After the fix, new joiners on the link are attached to the coach and see the now-paid package in their catalog to buy.

## Overlap
`src/packages/packages.service.ts` is also changed by open b#776 (archive/refund paths) and b#778 (read methods and the pricing-lock predicate). This PR adds one helper above the class and two lines after the `tx.coachPackage.update` in the lock transaction; it does not touch the predicate, archive, create or read methods, so either merge order is a clean merge.

No merge, deploy, production write, secrets or spend.
